subject: Joint webinar + Summit lounge: Redwood x Sage Solutions
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hendrix <sarah.hendrix@sagesol.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Joint webinar + Summit lounge: Redwood x Sage Solutions

Hi Sarah —

Great chatting last week. Sage's vector-DB integration with your extractor looks like a natural fit for a practical, engineer-focused session. Two things we wanted to float:

1) A 30–40 minute technical webinar the week of Aug 23 (demo + Q&A)
2) A small Redwood+Sage "partner lounge" at the Midwest AI Summit (Sept 14–15) — shared table, 2 short stage slots for a quick fireside and a live mini-demo run-through.

High-level asks from our side: proposed speakers from Sage (1 engineer, 1 product), a joint landing page, and shared promo tweets/email. We can cover webinar hosting, registration page, and a co-branded slide deck.

I've attached a one-pager that sketches a proposed webinar flow and a rough budget for the lounge. Can you confirm: are you comfortable with the summit lounge concept and do dates line up with Sage's events calendar?

If yes, we can pull Marissa in to scope marketing and Karthik for ops (AV / demo rig).

Thanks — looking forward to making this low-friction and high-value for devs.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Programs (Field) | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-sage-webinar-proposal-v1.pdf (1 page proposal; budget stub)

From: Sarah Hendrix <sarah.hendrix@sagesol.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sage Solutions Marketing <marketing@sagesol.com>, conference@midwestaisummit.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Joint webinar + Summit lounge: Redwood x Sage Solutions

Thanks Ben — excited about this. Confirming a few quick points:

- Webinar week Aug 23 works for Sage; we can do Aug 25 (Wed) at 10am PT.
- For the summit, we already budgeted a "partner corner" for smaller ecosystem partners, so the shared lounge is doable — we can commit to a 2-person presence for both days and the 15-minute fireside on Day 2.

Speakers: I'll propose: me (product lead) + Diego Ramos (backend engineer). Do you want a pre-recorded live demo or a live demo? Diego prefers a live demo but we can fall back to pre-recorded if AV is dicey.

Next steps from Sage:
- I'll loop in marketing to help with the landing page and social copy.
- I'll send over a short sponsor addendum (legal) and an AV requirements sheet.

I'll put Marissa's team in touch with our partner marketing lead (cc'd) and share proposed speaker bios later today.

Sarah
Sarah Hendrix
Head of Partnerships | Sage Solutions
sarah.hendrix@sagesol.com

Attachments: (none)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Hendrix <sarah.hendrix@sagesol.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood <> Sage: marketing & ops checklist (internal)

Marissa / Karthik / Irene — quick internal kickoff. Sarah at Sage confirmed Aug 25 for the webinar and the Summit lounge (Sept 14–15). Items I want us to triage: 

Marketing (Marissa):
- Target registration goal: 1,200 signups; primary audience: platform engineers and infra leads.
- Landing page copy & form; we’ll use our webinar template but add Sage co-branding.
- 2 emails (announcement + reminder), 3 social posts (LinkedIn/Twitter/Reddit dev community).
- Speaker bios (Sarah + Diego) to be finalized by Fri 7/16.

Ops (Karthik / Irene):
- Confirm demo rig (NVIDIA T4 at summit booth + fallback laptop). Karthik: estimate rental cost and AV hookups.
- Runbook for live demo with a pre-recorded fallback clip — Irene to own.
- DocuSign sponsor addendum: Sarah will send; we need legal to counter-sign quickly.

Budget: We have a small co-marketing pool — recommend $6k paid social + $2k production for short demo clip. Approve?

Attached: draft landing-page mock and the proposal Sarah saw. If you'd rather swap speakers to include an engineer from our infra team, say so and I can suggest Marcus or Diego (we have a Diego at Sage too — small name collision!).

Appreciate fast turnaround here — webinar date is 7 weeks out. I'll reply back to Sarah with our timeline once you confirm the asks.

— Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hendrix <sarah.hendrix@sagesol.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint webinar + Summit lounge: Redwood x Sage Solutions

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the quick confirm. A couple concrete next steps from Redwood:

1) We’ll lock webinar on Aug 25, 10am PT. I'll schedule hosting and share the registration link by Monday.
2) Marissa will own the landing page + promo; Karthik will follow up on AV and demo rig.
3) Please send the sponsor addendum when you have it; we’ll run it through legal and return with counters. If easier, we can sign the short addendum and finalize financials separately.

Budget ask: we propose Redwood covers $6k paid social and $2k production (we will take the lead on ad targeting). If Sage can commit to amplifying on your channels and share a small paid buffer ($1k) that should hit the registration target. Approve on your side?

Also attaching a draft landing-page mockup and the proposal for your legal team. Marissa — pinged you to draft a 2-week promo schedule. Karthik — can you confirm demo kit availability and rental estimate by Monday?

Thanks — Ben

Attachments: draft-landing-page-mockup.png, redwood-sage-webinar-proposal-v1.pdf

From: Sarah Hendrix <sarah.hendrix@sagesol.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sage Solutions Marketing <marketing@sagesol.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@sagesol.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Joint webinar + Summit lounge: Redwood x Sage Solutions

Ben — all good from our side. Quick confirmations: 

- Budget: Sage can commit $1k to paid amplification and cover Diego's travel for the summit.
- Addendum: attached (sponsor-addendum.docx); I've also created a DocuSign link for a quick signature: https://app.docusign.com/some-sign-link
- Speakers: Sarah Hendrix (product lead) + Diego Ramos (backend engineer) — Diego will do a live demo; he asked for a 20-min dry-run with your AV team the week before the summit.

Ask to Redwood: can you sign the addendum via DocuSign this week? Also, please send the calendly/cal link for the webinar host rehearsal so we can lock the 1-hour run-through in the calendar.

I'll have marketing share the first set of co-branded assets by Wed 7/21. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Sarah
